fix: Correct to 454 Main St, 732-549-9440, website runnershighnj.com, category 'running / athletic footwear retail'; drop the 'recently opened gift store' note.

claim: Cislo Siding & Construction, town = Metuchen, address 'Unknown'

claim: First Choice Plumbing (87 Forrest St, Metuchen) website = firstchoicenj.com, phone 848-420-8120
problem: firstchoicenj.com contains no Metuchen or Forrest St address and publishes 201-288-0390; its service pages are written for North Jersey. The Metuchen entity appearing on the BestProsInTown plumber/HVAC pages (87 Forrest St, 4.8/293 reviews) is a different listing whose site could not be confirmed. The mapper's own note flags the domain as unverified, so shipping it invites outreach to the wrong company.

claim: Chamber 43, 406 Main St Ste 27, 'clothing store', phone 732-322-5767
problem: Chamber 43 publishes chamber43.com and (732) 434-8840 and describes itself as a record shop / music creative space with a private appointment-only office; vintage apparel is bought, not retailed as a clothing store. The phone and category in the list do not match.
fix: Change category to 'record shop / music retail-cum-office', use 732-434-8840 and chamber43.com, and note the appointment-only, possibly home-office nature.

claim: Satch Cycles, 913 Middlesex Ave, category 'Bicycle shop'

claim: Flood Damage Pro, town = Metuchen, address 'Unknown'

problem: No source for a 'Hello Maid' house-cleaning business in Metuchen could be found; the only similar result is an unrelated 'Hello Cleaners' service-area page. The entry came from a maps result with no town label.

problem: Could not confirm a current business of this name at 406 Main St; the address is occupied by Optique Unique and other suites, and the only trace is a stale directory. The mapper's own note calls it new/thin.

claim: Excluded types still listed: Apple Montessori School (12 Center St), Kinder Kastle Childcare (740 Middlesex Ave), Cross Country Powersports (911 Middlesex Ave), Autoteam Car Rental (341 Amboy Ave)
problem: Apple Montessori is a multi-campus NJ school group and a school type (excluded twice over); Kinder Kastle runs six NJ childcare centres (chain); Cross Country Powersports is a multi-brand franchised new-vehicle dealership (Honda, Suzuki, Kawasaki, Triumph, Polaris, Can-Am, Royal Enfield); Autoteam is a multi-location NJ rental brand. All four were flagged as borderline by the mapper but left in the list.
fix: Apply the chain/franchise and school exclusions and remove all four, or ask the brief's owner for an explicit exception before outreach.
